title: Volcanoes that made history
summary: Knowable Magazine article exploring historical volcanic eruptions that significantly impacted human civilization and Earth's climate, discussing how events like Tambora, Krakatoa, and other major eruptions reshaped societies, altered weather patterns, and influenced global history.
problem_solved: Educates readers about the profound historical and environmental impacts of major volcanic eruptions on human civilization and planetary systems.
why_valuable: Provides accessible scientific and historical insights into how volcanic activity has shaped world history, climate, and human development, making complex geology understandable for general audiences.
